{{Quote|My mother fought off four raiders single-handedly when eight months pregnant, and returned to training when I was twelve weeks old.|[[Akaavi Spar]]|<ref name="TOR:Crossroads">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Akaavi Spar|Crossroads}}</ref>}}
'''Akaavi Spar's mother''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] living during the [[Great Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR:TToTY" /> A member of the respected [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Clan Spar]]<ref name="TOR:AS" /> along with her [[Akaavi Spar's father|husband]],<ref name="TOR:WFMWA" /> they had a daughter named [[Akaavi Spar]]. At the age of three, Spar left her mother to begin her Mandalorian training<ref name="TOR:TToTY" /> under her father;<ref name="TOR:WFMWA" /> this was tradition in the Mandalorian culture, though Spar began several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the more typically accepted age of eight years old.<ref name="TMPaC">''{{InsiderCite|86|The Mandalorians: People and Culture}}''</ref> By [[3642 BBY]], Clan Spar was destroyed, with Akaavi left as the only surviving member.<ref name="TOR:AS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Akaavi Spar's mother is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Akaavi Spar companion mission.<ref name="TOR:TToTY" />
